projectDescription: SmartPyme is a cloud-based business management platform for SMEs covering sales, inventory, purchasing, accounting, payroll, electronic invoicing, and restaurant operations.
keyFeatures: Point-of-sale and sales management with quotations, returns, and recurring sales
Multi-warehouse inventory management with stock tracking, batch lots, and product transfers
Electronic invoicing (DTE) compliant with El Salvador Ministry of Finance
Purchasing management with purchase orders, supplier accounts payable, and expense tracking
Accounting module with IVA books, assets, petty cash, and project budgets
Payroll module with employee management, salary calculation, bonuses, and loans
Restaurant module with table maps, kitchen orders, reservations, and pre-billing
Customer loyalty program with points, tiers, and redemption
Customizable analytics dashboard with charts for sales, expenses, and inventory
External API for B2B third-party integrations (read-only, API Key auth)
WooCommerce and Shopify integrations for e-commerce sync
Multi-branch (sucursales) and multi-user support with role-based access
